ops.title: Scratch-dir writes fix: permission bypass design
ops.body:
# Fixes pack: auto-approve scratch-dir writes under skip-permissions

Approved plan (2026-07-14). Motivation: bypass-launched sessions still pop dialogs for file-tool writes to scratch space — plan mode overrides bypass consent (subagent `Write` to `../../../../tmp/sweep_arc.py` prompted mid-plan), and teammate forwarded dialogs (issue #73176) do the same for writes the `teammate bash under skip-permissions` hook doesn't cover.

## Decisions (user-confirmed)

- Gate on the **bypass launch flag alone** (`SkipPermissions()`), NOT `InPlanMode()` — a subagent's dialog payload may report the child's own `permission_mode`, so plan-mode gating would miss the observed case.
- Scratch = **system temp roots + scratch-named directory components** (`tmp/temp/scratch/scratchpad/scratchpads`), judged on the **realpath-resolved** target (relative paths resolve against payload `cwd`; kills `/tmp/../` spoofs and symlink tricks).
- All native file tools: `Tool("Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit")`; MCP vetoed via `McpTool()`. No `FromSubagent()` — the path predicate is the guard.
- `approve(..., events=Event.PreToolUse | Event.PermissionRequest)` — dual registration is load-bearing (forwarded teammate dialogs run zero PermissionRequest hooks).

## Shape

1. Public `BaseHookEvent.cwd` property (`events.py`, after `transcript_path`) + `Input(cwd=...)` seeding (`testing/types.py` FIELD_TYPES, `testing/helpers.py` mock_tool_event/input_to_event) + `test_public_api.py` rows. Payload `cwd` is sent on every hook event (already read at `review/pipeline.py:166`, `daemon/protocol.py:148`).
2. `packs/fixes/_lib.py` holding `McpTool` (two consumers now; loader skips `_`-prefixed files, `loader.py:172`).
3. `packs/fixes/scratch_writes.py`: `ScratchPath(CustomCondition)` — `((evt.cwd or Path.cwd()) / file.path).resolve()` then temp-root membership (`TEMP_ROOTS` resolved at import: /tmp, /private/tmp, /var/folders, /dev/shm, `tempfile.gettempdir()`) or `SCRATCH_DIR_NAMES.isdisjoint(resolved.parts[:-1])` — `parts[:-1]` so a *file* named tmp doesn't approve.
4. `tests/test_packs.py`: `FIXES_HOOKS` pin + `test_fixes_pack_approves_scratch_writes`.
5. Docs: `events.qmd` cwd, `packs.qmd` two hooks; CHANGELOG minor bump (pick next free off PyPI at commit time).

## Pitfalls

- Temp roots resolved at both ends (macOS `/var` → `/private/var`).
- NotebookEdit inline-test rows need verbatim `tool_input={"notebook_path": ...}` (`make_tool_input` has no NotebookEdit case → `OtherCall`, `evt.file is None`).
- Bare `Input(file=...)` infers `Edit` (`helpers.py:624-630`) — always set `content`/`old`.
- No existence guards: `Path.resolve()` is non-strict; `exists()` would break first-write.
- `gettempdir()` freezes per hookd worker (first client's TMPDIR; not reqenv-whitelisted) — acceptable, `/var/folders` backstops macOS.
- Repo dogfoods the pack live — a Python error in the pack file LoadErrors the next event in the working session.

## Verification

Targeted pytest (`test_packs`, `test_public_api`, `test_testing`, `test_approve`) + `uv run capt-hook test`; 2× codex xhigh adversarial review (approver-bypass focus); live tmux bypass+plan session probe (headless `-p` runs zero PermissionRequest hooks) — positive `../../../../tmp/probe.py` no-dialog, negative repo-path still prompts; full suite + great-docs build (public API grew `evt.cwd`).
ops.when: implementing or revisiting the fixes-pack auto-approve for scratch-dir writes under skip-permissions (scratch_writes.py / evt.cwd)
